title: Visita de Huaraz Pre-Conquest / Early Census by Principal (m_60, 7 complete principales)
source_citation: Textos Andinos m_60 (Visita de los repartimientos de Guaraz y Llaguaraz, Lic. Diego Álvarez; KFG textosbook)
region: Huaraz, Ancash (Callejón de Huaylas / Santa Basin)
editorial_notes: Verbatim 7-column counts for the 7 principales with complete declarations in m_60. Principal #1 (Don Hernando Guamacochache) lacks the initial casas/casados header line in the surviving text and is excluded rather than imputed; Pedro Yana (mitimaes Yauyos, 8 casas, 5 casados, 3 mozos, 0 mozas, 4 muchachos, 14 ninos, 5 viudos) is omitted from the 7-row core because mozas is unmentioned.
